representative_summary: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY silently no-ops through Supabase's PgBouncer pooler (port 6543) in transaction mode

payload.symptom: Migration applied with no error, but the index never built
payload.root_cause: PgBouncer transaction-mode pooler doesn't support CONCURRENTLY (requires its own transaction)

representative_summary: Strip CONCURRENTLY at pipe-time when applying migrations through the Supabase pooler

payload.note: At current row counts (<10k), the lack of CONCURRENTLY isn't user-visible. Real-scale will need a direct (5432) connection.
